data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial background plate only: a warm attainable living room after a white-elephant exchange, with a low pale travertine coffee table, torn heavyweight cream wrapping paper, one loose burgundy grosgrain ribbon, a softly blurred walnut chair and wool rug, and a truly empty central product-sized placement area. Use diffuse late-afternoon window light, believable soft shadows, natural materials, subtle film grain, and a calm blank warm-plaster upper quarter. Generate no product, package, person, child, fire, smoke, toy, headline, letters, logo, price, badge, CTA, watermark, collage, frame, UI, or product card.
notes: The generated plate contains the requested empty travertine contact plane, torn cream paper, burgundy ribbon, warm wall field, and no product or readable text.
